request.description: Compile the protected two-joint MuJoCo model and measure its effective joint limits, inertial properties, branch contact behavior, and bounded 50 Hz step responses with braking and coast-down.

measurements.label: initial compiled dynamics and sampled response characterization

request.rationale: The initial unresolved distinction is whether early progress is primarily limited by physical control authority and sampled-data settling or by learned policy behavior. This candidate-free measurement directly tests the model assumptions about compiler-derived dynamics, joint limits, self-contact, and braking. If responses settle rapidly with adequate authority and branches are collision-free, the next direction should prioritize policy learning and hold diagnostics; if settling is slow, saturated, asymmetric, or branch contacts occur, the first learning design should explicitly account for stabilization, action bandwidth, or branch selection.

measurements.label: initial compiled dynamics and sampled response characterization

request.description: Train a baseline PPO policy with the current task observation, reward, and training distribution.
request.rationale: M1 found active joint limits, collision-free principal branches, and strong but rapidly settling actuation, so the plant is not presently the primary reason to defer learning. A baseline candidate is needed to measure whether the learned policy can enter and maintain the 1 cm set. Its development evaluation will distinguish reach failure from hold interruption and expose radius, angle, or branch-dependent weaknesses before changing the policy route.

request.description: Evaluate the non-terminal late-training PPO checkpoint T1:checkpoint-115712 on a fresh 200-episode research panel and retain per-episode reach, hold, interruption, and target-geometry diagnostics.
request.rationale: Training success rose to 0.96 by 115712 steps, but training statistics do not establish development performance and the later checkpoint is not privileged. M1 supports adequate plant authority, so this measurement tests whether the remaining gap is learned stabilization or geometry/branch-specific behavior. High success with few interruptions supports the current route; concentrated failures, long first reach, or near-complete holds would redirect the next inquiry toward stabilization, representation, or targeted training rather than a blind recipe change.

scientific_session.objective: Establish the most credible initial scientific direction toward the human goal from the scientific model and available evidence. Use scientific work in this session to establish or refine that direction, including building or adapting reusable scientific tools and PI-owned methods where needed. These capabilities can support subsequent inquiries. Choose the first useful scientific action and explain why it advances the direction. Preserve the work actually performed, resulting understanding, remaining uncertainties and chosen next action in the scientific session record.
